description: find_trust_anchor (line 586) performs a linear scan over all anchors for every call to validate_path. For a system trust store with hundreds of anchors (e.g. Mozilla NSS has ~150), this is O(anchors) per validation. For high-throughput TLS servers validating many chains per second this becomes a bottleneck. There is no documentation of this complexity, no suggestion to pre-index by subject name hash, and no note that callers should pass a filtered anchor slice. Document the O(n) complexity in the validate_path rustdoc and add a note recommending callers pre-filter anchors by subject name before calling.
title: anchor scan is O(n) per validation with no documented complexity
